svg.aria-label: Sandboxes running across six machines, with latency by idle time, under traffic, and by heap size

g.text: Python HTTP servers created at 20/s. Afterwards 1,198 of 1,200 picked at random were called and answered.
286, every sandbox kept in memory (Docker + gVisor: 189)
64 MiB heap. Frozen after 15 s idle, on disk after 60 s.
40 per node, where about 12 fit awake. Zipf popularity.
Python with numpy and a heap every request reads.
Median time to restore a snapshot, by heap.
